pages.title: One Last Toast
pages.text: Demonstrate the advanced station in use.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Obtain the Netherite station yourself. Complete one recipe it supports; no specific quality roll or creature encounter is required.

pages.title: Upgrade brewing equipment
pages.text: Upgrade Wooden Brewingstations to Copper and then Netherite at a Smithing Table. Higher tiers change the available recipes and manual upkeep.

pages.title: Display a brewing completion reward
pages.text: Inspect the Brewery Banner recipe and tooltip after the late station upgrade. It has its own nearby working benefit; arbitrary decorative cloth does not share that power.
